claims.claim: For dragons to be believed, everything ordinary must match our reality, down to the hero spilling his coffee.
claims.quote: the hero spills his cup of hot coffee

claims.claim: She does not smooth life out for her characters; it is never going to be all pony rides.
claims.quote: everything is always going to be pony rides

claims.claim: She avoids the language that reaches for 'throbbing' anything.
To write any viewpoint she puts the character on like a coat and believes everything they believe for the duration.
claims.quote: put that character on like a coat

claims.claim: Inside any viewpoint, even the villain is wondering what is for dinner.
claims.quote: even the villain is wondering what is for dinner

claims.claim: As Hobb she sprawls in novels and knows it; her Lindholm prose is much leaner.
claims.quote: In a novel, I sprawl, and I know it

claims.claim: The Hobb voice is leisurely, with more emotion and more pausing over what characters think or feel, where Lindholm reports what happened.
claims.quote: writes in a much more leisurely manner

claims.claim: The Hobb name was created to write with a depth of feeling she did not usually indulge.
claims.quote: a depth of feeling that I didn't usually indulge

claims.claim: A story idea belongs immediately and unmistakably to one of the two voices.

claims.feature: story equals how events affect characters
claims.claim: The story is about how events affect the characters, not about the events.
claims.quote: how the events affect the characters

claims.feature: every character main character of own story
claims.claim: Each character, villain included, is written as the main character in his own story.
claims.quote: the main character in his own story

claims.feature: vocabulary as a way of seeing
claims.claim: Characters are differentiated by vocabulary, sentence structure, slang and cadence, because word choice is a way of seeing.
claims.quote: Choice of vocabulary, it's a way of seeing things

claims.claim: How a character reacts to an event reveals more than exposition does.
A believable character is shaped by the world they grew up in, not dropped into it.
claims.quote: The character has to be shaped by the world

claims.claim: In any description she tries to engage as many of the five senses as possible.
claims.quote: engage as many of them as possible
